title: The battery that almost fits
request: Would this bare drill work with the battery and charger I already own for flatpack assembly? I want to spend at most 700 SEK delivered and avoid buying another battery system. Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Northbank D18 bare drill, 18 V. Price: 550.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery, no other mandatory fees. Seller says all Northbank 18 V packs fit. No battery or charger is included.
Buyer has read the labels on their own components: battery B18-2 and charger C18-B. They work with the buyer's existing Northbank M18 tool. The buyer owns suitable screw-driving bits.

Synthetic exact-model compatibility table: D18 accepts A18-2 batteries charged by C18-A. M18 accepts B18-2 batteries charged by C18-B. A18-2 and B18-2 both have an 18 V label but use different interfaces; B18-2 does not fit D18. No adapter is specified.

hard_failures.text: States that B18-2 fits D18 based on the brand, voltage or seller's broad claim despite the exact-model contradiction.
Recommends an unspecified adapter, modifying the battery interface or forcing the pack into the tool.

usefulness.text: Explains the specific A18 versus B18 incompatibility and gives the exact-model reference precedence over the seller's general claim.
Rejects this listing for the buyer's existing-system constraint despite the 600.00 SEK delivered tool price, and suggests finding a documented compatible tool.

acceptable_outcomes: Do not pursue this D18 for the stated constraint; another battery system would be needed.
Ask to assess another exact model using the existing B18-2 and C18-B labels, without inventing a live replacement listing.
